_comment: Items from nearMiss on (docs/brainstorm.md) are roster-only: no mechanics yet, shared placeholder icon, every baseSuccess/effectPower/xpReward/price is a placeholder tagged for balance until playtest. consumablePrices follow xpReward x 6 except introduction (200) and nostalgia (280): lore goods priced toward Rejuvenation (280). PROSE-REVIEW: description of every item from nearMiss on.

timePearl.name: Time Pearl
timePearl.description: Throw at your feet. Freezes enemy for N turns. Elegant, if you ignore what it actually is.

enhancementPowder.name: Enhancement Powder
enhancementPowder.description: Rub on skin before a fight. Life-type acceleration — you act faster than anyone can track.
enhancementPowder.effectText: An extra action each round for 1 round (2 at top power).

rewind.name: Rewind
rewind.description: Shaped like an hourglass. Briefly unspools time — only you remember what happened. Difficult and expensive to produce.
rewind.effectText: Rewinds a fight 1–5 rounds (top tier: to its start), an event one card, or the last bench craft.

healingSalve.name: Healing Salve
healingSalve.description: Rubbed on the worst of it. Speeds up what your body was doing anyway. No drama, mildly less itching.
healingSalve.effectText: Heals 2–6 HP a day for 2 days.

blast.name: Blast
blast.description: A concentrated shove of physics calc. Knocks them back, occasionally knocks the gun out of their hand. Mostly the former.
blast.effectText: 4–12 damage to one enemy, ignoring guard.

shield.name: Shield
shield.description: Absorbs the next couple of hits, then quietly stops working. Recharges itself if you're lucky, which is not a policy.
shield.effectText: Absorbs 3–8 damage and keeps you Guarded while it lasts.

blackHole.name: Black Hole
blackHole.description: A localised gravity fault, contained mostly to the size of a dinner plate. Everything nearby gets pulled toward the middle — you keep your distance and let it do the work.
blackHole.effectText: 6–16 damage to every enemy; each loses 1–3 actions.

prophetsBreath.name: Prophet's Breath
prophetsBreath.description: Two lungfuls buys you a few seconds of foresight. Enough to flinch correctly.

beALady.name: Be a Lady
beALady.description: For one action, the numbers stop arguing with you. Fate calc, temporarily very agreeable.
beALady.effectText: Your own cultivating and harvesting take the best result.

panic.name: Panic
panic.description: Fear, pressed down until it keeps. Aimed at a crowd, it does not stay a crowd for long.
panic.effectText: One enemy panics for 2–5 actions: each, it cowers or bolts (50%).

panger.name: Panger
panger.description: Anger, ground fine. The target stops being careful and starts being loud.
panger.effectText: One enemy deals more and takes less for 2 turns, then the reverse for 2.

pandemonium.name: Pandemonium
pandemonium.description: Fury, brought to the boil. Nobody in range remembers whose side they were on.
pandemonium.effectText: As Panger, and the enemy attacks another enemy instead.

pansRapture.name: Pan's Rapture
pansRapture.description: Joy, distilled to the last clear drop. Pleasant until you notice nobody is going home.
pansRapture.effectText: One enemy skips its next 2–5 actions.

healingBurst.name: Healing Burst
healingBurst.description: Faster than the salve, weaker than patience. Time and life calc, for when you don't have either.
healingBurst.effectText: Heals you or an ally 6–15 HP.

failsafe.name: Failsafe
failsafe.description: Reverses your death, administratively. Expensive because dying is expensive to undo, and everyone in the trade knows it.
failsafe.effectText: On a lethal hit, rewinds the fight 1–2 rounds.

rejuvenation.name: Rejuvenation
rejuvenation.description: Does nothing you'd notice. Sells for more than anything else on this bench, which tells you who's buying it.

wormhole.name: Wormhole
wormhole.description: Folds the distance between two points until there isn't any. Costs what you'd expect for something that ignores geography.
wormhole.effectText: Flees any fight at once, or travels to a district with no ambush.

nearMiss.name: Near Miss
nearMiss.description: The bullet had somewhere else to be. You will not get an explanation, and neither will it.
nearMiss.effectText: The next 1–3 strikes at you miss.

sodsLaw.name: Sod's Law
sodsLaw.description: Whatever can go wrong for them now does, in order of inconvenience.
sodsLaw.effectText: One enemy's next 1–4 strikes roll their minimum damage.

happyAccident.name: Happy Accident
happyAccident.description: You trip on exactly the right paving stone.
happyAccident.effectText: Your next read is sharper and your crafting steadier.

introduction.name: Introduction
introduction.description: Arranges for two people to be in the same queue at the same time. What happens next is not covered.

smellingSalts.name: Smelling Salts
smellingSalts.description: Wakes anyone who is still technically in there. Ask them how they feel later.
smellingSalts.effectText: Revives a downed ally at 5–20 HP; out of combat, clears a contact's KO cooldown.

rootFeed.name: Root Feed
rootFeed.effectText: Apply to a vein: it grows a little extra each day.
rootFeed.description: Life calc, worked into the seam like bone meal. The vein grows, and resents it slightly.

bloom.name: Bloom
bloom.description: Keeps cut flowers fresh for a month. Covent Garden buys it by the crate and nobody asks why.

borrowedTime.name: Borrowed Time
borrowedTime.description: Gives you back an afternoon. The afternoon will want it back.
borrowedTime.effectText: Banks 1–2 extra time blocks; low tiers owe blocks back.

patina.name: Patina
patina.description: Ages anything about a century overnight. The Bermondsey antiques trade's best-kept open secret.

ricochet.name: Ricochet
ricochet.description: The next thing that hits you keeps going, back the way it came.
ricochet.effectText: The next strike that lands on you returns 3–12 damage.

deadweight.name: Deadweight
deadweight.effectText: Apply to HQ or a vein: raids carry off less ore.
deadweight.description: Makes a safe weigh four tonnes for anyone who isn't you.

signalFailure.name: Signal Failure
signalFailure.description: The target's reinforcements are held at a red signal. They are not told why.

trueLevel.name: True Level
trueLevel.description: Makes a crooked house straight on a survey. The house stays crooked. Surveyors pay well.

dejaVu.name: Déjà Vu
dejaVu.description: You have done this before. It went differently. You remember how.
dejaVu.effectText: On an event check, shows the exact roll before you commit.

skeletonKey.name: Skeleton Key
skeletonKey.description: Not a key. A strong opinion about which way a lock should be.
skeletonKey.effectText: Opens a barrier option in an event: no roll, no alert.

goodYear.name: Good Year
goodYear.effectText: Apply to a vein: harvests yield as if its terroir were a tier higher.
goodYear.description: Not more ore. Better ore, which is worse news for the people buying it.

secondImpression.name: Second Impression
secondImpression.effectText: Every relation you gain with a contact is boosted.
secondImpression.description: Nobody remembers the first one. You've made sure of it.

stutter.name: Stutter
stutter.description: A very short hop. You're behind them before they've finished looking at where you were.
stutter.effectText: Strikes an enemy from behind, ignoring guard, +15–40% crit; nothing single-target hits you that round.

invisibility.name: Invisibility
invisibility.description: Does what it says on the tin. The tin is also, somehow, missing.
invisibility.effectText: Single-target attacks miss you for 1–3 rounds; passes a stealth check in an event.

stiffUpperLip.name: Stiff Upper Lip
stiffUpperLip.description: Fear is noted and filed for later. Much later.
stiffUpperLip.effectText: For 2–6 rounds you and allies resist Pan effects and take 10–30% less damage.

heavyMetal.name: Heavy Metal
heavyMetal.description: Every enemy in range hears it. Most of them wish they hadn't.
heavyMetal.effectText: 3–10 damage to every enemy; the weakest may bolt.

coldFeet.name: Cold Feet
coldFeet.effectText: Holding one opens a way out of certain events.

nostalgia.name: Nostalgia
nostalgia.description: A bottled afternoon from 1987. People pay to cry at it.

navvysDraught.name: Navvy's Draught
navvysDraught.description: What the men who dug the Underground drank, allegedly. +Constitution, −table manners.
navvysDraught.effectText: Your next fight starts with extra max and current HP.

cleanSlate.name: Clean Slate
cleanSlate.description: Everyone involved remembers it differently, and slightly in your favour.
cleanSlate.effectText: Turns a failed social check into a success.

keystone.name: Keystone
keystone.description: Holds the arch up by being exactly where it is. Proof you can work every ore, which is a short list of people.
